(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (split-panels grid)
      (let ((seps (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 5)) (range 0 (rows grid))))
                          (range 0 (cols grid)))))
        (let loop ([remaining (append seps (list (cols grid)))] [start 0] [panels (list)])
          (if (empty? remaining)
              (reverse panels)
              (let ((stop (first remaining)))
                (loop (rest remaining) (+ stop 1)
                      (if (> stop start) (cons (subgrid grid 0 start (- (rows grid) 1) (- stop 1)) panels) panels)))))))
    (define (transform-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (transpose grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (define (binary grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 1))))
    (let* ((panels (split-panels g))
           (a (crop-to-content (first panels)))
           (b (crop-to-content (second panels)))
           (c (crop-to-content (third panels)))
           (code (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (t) (equal? (transform-code (binary a) t) (binary b)))
                                        (list 1 2 3 4 5 6))))
                   (if hit hit 1)))
           (dst (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (grid-colors b 0))))
           (tc (transform-code c code)))
      (grid-from-fn (rows tc) (cols tc)
        (lambda (r c) (if (= (at tc r c) 0) 0 dst))))))
